area_def.name: Lisbon and the Atlantic approaches: within 250 nautical miles (463 km) of 38.75 N, 9.20 W (LPPT is 8 km north of the centre)

about: Aircraft adsb.lol's community receivers saw in Lisbon and the Atlantic approaches: within 250 nautical miles (463 km) of 38.75 N, 9.20 W (LPPT is 8 km north of the centre), 2026-11-12 04:00 to :59 UTC, one frame per poll (Lisbon every 5 minutes, Madeira every 20). Fact: what adsb.lol shows at the time read (frames[].t; frames[].request holds the URL, status, bytes and sha256 of the raw response, which is in our vault). rows: airline flights (an airline's ICAO code plus a flight number), one array per aircraft in the order of fields. others: every other aircraft, one array in the order of other_fields: its ADS-B emitter category and position only, with no callsign, no ICAO24 address, no registration and no type, so nothing names a private owner; altitude rounded to 100 ft. Aircraft whose owners asked to be withheld (PIA or LADD in adsb.lol's data) are dropped and only counted. pos_age_s: how old each position was when read. Nothing between frames is measured: a line or a moving dot drawn between two frames is a drawing (hypothesis), not a position.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.

units.alt_ft: feet, barometric (geometric when barometric is absent); null on the ground
units.pos_age_s: seconds since the position was received
units.category: ADS-B emitter category (A1 light, A2 small, A3 large, A4 B757, A5 heavy, A7 rotorcraft, B1 glider, B6 drone, C1-C3 surface; null not sent)

cadence: one frame every 5 minutes (a missed or failed poll leaves a gap; each frame's t is when it was read)
